evals.prompt: Write captions from tags: subjects Dexter cattle, season winter, mood peaceful, contentType pasture, description green winter pasture at The Branch.
evals.expected_output: JSON with caption_a (storytelling), caption_b (short/visual max 150 chars), caption_c (educational), plus google_post and email_excerpt channel copy.
assertions: Output includes three distinct caption variants with different editorial angles
caption_b is at most 150 characters before hashtags
Variants do not share the same opening word or phrase
First-person plural brand voice; no clichés from brand-voice avoid list (farm fresh, paddock to plate)
Hashtags are not embedded in caption body text
